newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China to send 4,000 troops into HK on July 1.
newsitem.headline: China to send 4,000 troops into HK on July 1.

text.p: Beijing will send 4,000 troops backed by helicopters, ships and armoured vehicles across the border into Hong Kong on the first day of Chinese rule on July 1, the office of Hong Kong's future leader said on Friday.
The forces, arriving six hours after Britain returns the wealthy colony to Chinese rule, will cross the northern border at three points.

The number of troops is larger than any figure given so far. It also includes 10 ships, six helicopters, 21 armoured cars and 400 other vehicles, the statement issued by the office of Hong Kong's Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa said.
China's People's Liberation Army already has 196 advance troops in Hong Kong and another 509 are to join them shortly before the handover ceremony at midnight (1600 GMT) on June 30.
